summary: viper-1.2 delivers the free audio + quality answer: new audio command writes audio/AUDIO_<project>.ipynb (Kokoro or Chatterbox voice, MMAudio/ThinkSound foley, MusicGen bed, receipt), new mix command builds per-shot ffmpeg graphs (vo+foley amix, sidechain-ducked bed, optional loudnorm -16 LUFS, video copied), shot_media prefers -mix stems, verify fails when stems exist but the file has no audio stream, plan prints non-commercial licence warnings, knowledge/AUDIO.md documents the researched stack (with licence reality) and the Ovi/Kandinsky 24GB wall, tool_registry.json extended with 7 audio models in the existing schema, docs/VIDEOGEN.md + WF-07 README + INDEX updated, 120 tests OK, validate 25/1/0, manifest 1000 files, Drive synced to 15 files.
